vulnerabilities.description: FIREBASE_API_KEY hardcoded and committed to repository. Exposed API key can be used for unauthorized Firebase operations, potential data breach.
PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY hardcoded and committed to repository. Exposed secret key allows unauthorized payment processing and financial fraud.
GROQ_API_KEY hardcoded and committed to repository. Can be used for unauthorized API calls, causing financial loss.
GEMINI_API_KEY hardcoded and committed to repository. Exposed credential enables unauthorized API access and costs.
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY hardcoded and committed to repository. Secret key can be exploited for unauthorized API calls and billing fraud.
innerHTML used to set button content. While currently hardcoded, this is a potential XSS vector if error messages or dynamic content are rendered here.
User validation error messages exposed in redirect alert. Information disclosure vulnerability - attackers can enumerate valid email patterns and user validation rules.
PDF.js worker loaded from external CDN (https://esm.run/pdfjs-dist@4.0.379/build/pdf.worker.mjs). Supply chain attack vector - CDN compromise could inject malicious code.
No file type validation before processing files. Client-side file upload should validate MIME types and file extensions. Users could upload malicious files.
System command execution with external binary detection. While hardcoded binary names are used, verify proper argument escaping to prevent command injection.
Console error logging with detailed Firebase error messages. Error details exposed in browser console could reveal system architecture to attackers.
Console logging in production code. Remove debug console.log() statements from production builds.

recommendations: URGENT: Move all API keys from .env to environment variables managed by deployment platform (Heroku, etc.). Rotate ALL exposed keys immediately in Firebase, Paystack, Groq, Gemini, and Anthropic consoles.
URGENT: Remove .env file from git history using `git-filter-repo` or `BFG Repo-Cleaner`. Add .env to .gitignore.
Add pre-commit hook to prevent committing secrets: install `git-secrets` or `detect-secrets` and configure in husky/pre-commit.
Replace all innerHTML assignments with textContent or createElement() to prevent XSS vulnerabilities.
Host PDF.js worker locally instead of loading from third-party CDN to eliminate supply chain attack vector.
Implement server-side file type validation using file magic numbers (MIME type checking), not just extensions.
Remove or sanitize validation error messages exposed to users. Log full errors server-side for debugging.
Remove all console.log(), console.error() statements from production code. Use a proper logging service.
Enable Content Security Policy (CSP) headers to mitigate XSS attacks.
Set secure cookie flags: HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Strict for session cookies.
Run `bundle exec bundle-audit` regularly to scan for vulnerable gems.
Run Brakeman static analysis on Rails code: `brakeman --no-summary` to catch security issues.
Implement request size limits on file uploads to prevent DoS attacks.
Add rate limiting to API endpoints to prevent abuse.
